name: week
title: Disclosure desk: this week
subtitle: Review snapshot. Dates and records must be checked before decisions.

sections.title: Declaration rounds
sections.sql: select * from v_rounds order by due_on

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by due_on nulls first,code

sections.title: Active disclosures
sections.sql: select code,person,department,title,entity,position,monitor,next_review_on from v_register order by code

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select a.code,d.code as disclosure,p.name as owner,a.title,a.due_on from actions a join disclosures d on d.id=a.disclosure_id join people p on p.id=a.owner_id where a.status='open' order by due_on
